verdict.rationale: Entra's first-party docs describe Lifecycle Workflows, which manage users across the three phases of their lifecycle with workflows that run automatically as users move through it. Automatic provisioning into SaaS apps (Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow) and on-premises apps covers the app-by-app side. The evidence clearly supports the core of the story, but the specifics are thin. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the no-code workflow designer, documented event triggers for hire/role-change/departure by name, detail on per-app task orchestration within workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
